correctness.rationale: All positive triples are covered. Unary and alternating targets give three upper bounds. Cyclic subsequence transitivity reduces to m=1,2,3. Independent script checks 144 triples, 14270 length-k targets and 144 sharpness obstructions.

value.rationale: This exactly classifies cyclic target-dependent scattered-factor coverage for a natural three-parameter repeated-run family, distinguishes it from the classical one-common-rotation variant, and exposes a saturation transition at minimum run length three. It supplies a reusable explicit finite-state greedy displacement proof, not just enumeration.
